answer: Zero-knowledge proof of post-epoch generation at the copper: each miner proves a unique nonce was derived after epoch close, so precomputed identities fail. Yarrow entropy seeds the challenge, forcing fresh work per proof. A farm of k identities must re-solve k distinct proofs, each costing ~500 CPU-hours (~$12), so 100 sybils burn $1,200 per epoch on the terrace of validators. Verdict: pre-generation is impossible, making sybil cost scale linearly with identity count.
